head: cloud/chat-validation-messages
title: fix(serve): report non-string models and documented reasoning efforts in Chat errors
body:
This PR fixes two Chat Completions validation errors that do not match what the request sent or what the docs list:

- **Non-string `model`.** `ParseRequest` read `model` with `member_str`, which returns `""` for a non-string. `{"model":5,...}` was therefore answered with `'model' is required` / `missing_model`. It now returns 400 `'model' must be a string` with code `invalid_model`. The text matches the compatibility routes (`ReadCompatibilityOptions`), and the code is the one the audio, TTS and video routes use for a bad model. An absent or null `model` still gets `missing_model`.
- **`reasoning_effort` values.** The error listed `off, minimal, low, …`. `docs/SERVER.md` documents `none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max`. The parser accepts both `off` and `none`, so only the message changes, to list the documented `none`.

`openai_chat_test` (`TestStopSequencesAndDefaultFields`) checks both messages.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending. The change is in Chat request validation only, so no GPU path is touched.

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope (x86-64 CPU host, GCC 13.3, `cpu-test` preset, no GPU):
- Before the source change, the new `openai_chat_test` assertion failed. After it, `ctest --test-dir build/cpu-test -R '^openai_chat_test$'` passes.
- `cmake --build --preset pr` (hosted contract suite) on this branch: 56/56 tests passed.
- `tools/ci/check-format.py` (clang-tools 21.1.8 via `nix shell`): PASS, 563 C++ files.
- Not run: sanitizers, functional tests or any model.
